name: Nikaidou Mana
source:
A girl who attends the same school as the main characters. She and Kana are sisters.  She is weak and tends to miss school, and is rarely seen at the school. 

She is always out of her mind and has a unique atmosphere.  She meets the protagonist by chance when she is in trouble, and they get to know each other by helping her solve her problems. 

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/steal/mana.html]official site[/url]]
